additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively maps Extension to the extensibility page and ElementDefinition to the elementdefinition page, so the inspected source locations are in the current build path. FHIR-I minutes for 2021-08-02 record the same Persuasive motion at 10-0-0. Quoted Zulip and Confluence full-text searches found no conflicting discussion beyond the Confluence vote reference.
